The second season of the ''[[Naruto (TV series)|Naruto]]'' [[anime]] television series, labelled as the "2nd Stage" in the Japanese DVD release, is directed by Hayato Date, and produced by [[Pierrot (company)|Studio Pierrot]] and [[TV Tokyo]]. Based on [[Masashi Kishimoto]]'s [[manga]] [[Naruto|series of the same name]], the season follows [[Naruto Uzumaki]] and fellow genin-ranked ninja participating the Chūnin Exams, surviving [[Orochimaru]]'s invasion of the Hidden Leaf Village and confronting [[Gaara]] in the Leaf Forest. The season ran from June 4, 2003, to May 12, 2004, on TV Tokyo and its affiliates, consisting of 48 episodes.{{efn|The number of episodes are based on how [[Sony Pictures Entertainment|Sony]] / [[Aniplex]] divides the seasons (stages) of ''Naruto'' in its original Japanese home media release. The number of seasons and how many episodes each has varies depending on the series distributor. Some other ways the first season could be split based on streaming services and home video releases are as follows:
* [[Viz Media]] and [[Hulu]] season 2: Eps. 53–106<ref>[https://www.viz.com/anime/tv-series/naruto-uncut-video-box-sets-season-2-volume-1/product/4250 Viz Media DVD]</ref><ref>[https://www.viz.com/anime/tv-series/naruto-uncut-video-box-sets-season-2-volume-2/product/4251 Viz Media DVD 2]</ref> (54 episodes)
* [[Netflix]] and [[Crunchyroll]] season 2: Eps. 27–52 (26 episodes)
* [[Netflix]] season 3: Eps. 53–80 (28 episodes)
* [[Crunchyroll]] season 3: Eps. 53–78 (26 episodes)
* [[Apple TV+]] season 2: Eps. 58–100<ref>[https://tv.apple.com/us/show/naruto/umc.cmc.3i5nwaw2x5ejk401dxbs92rbm Naruto] at [[Apple TV+]]</ref> (43 episodes)}}<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/naruto2002/stuff_f.html|title=Naruto staff|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=June 8, 2009}}</ref><ref name="tvtokyo">{{Cite web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/naruto2002/story_f.html|title=Naruto story|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=June 5, 2009}}</ref>

The English dub aired on both [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Toonami]] and [[YTV (Canadian TV channel)|YTV]]'s [[Bionix (TV programming block)|Bionix]] programming blocks from June 3, 2006, to April 14, 2007.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2008-11-17/viz-to-stream-naruto-within-1-week-of-japanese-airing|title=Viz to Stream Naruto on Naruto.com Within 1 Week of Japanese Airing (Updated)|publisher=[[Anime News Network]]|date=November 17, 2008|access-date=June 8, 2009}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2007-07-19/canada's-ytv-to-premiere-death-note-anime-in-september|title=Canada's YTV to Premiere Death Note Anime in September|publisher=[[Anime News Network]]|date=July 19, 2007|access-date=June 8, 2009}}</ref> The season's episodes ran on [[Adult Swim]]'s relaunched Toonami block in a completely uncut format from December 1, 2012, to November 30, 2013. After the 52nd episode, it was removed from the schedule rotation to make room for its successor series, ''[[Naruto: Shippuden]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2012-11-22/naruto-to-run-uncut-on-adult-swim-toonami-block|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161114211617/https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2012-11-22/naruto-to-run-uncut-on-adult-swim-toonami-block|archive-date=November 14, 2016|title=Naruto to run uncut on Adult Swim's Toonami Block|publisher=[[Anime News Network]]|date=November 11, 2012|url-status=dead}}</ref>

[[Sony Pictures Entertainment]] collected the episodes in a total of twelve DVD volumes under the name "2nd Stage",<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/naruto2002/goods/dvd_02.html|title=2nd Stage|publisher=TV Tokyo|language=ja|access-date=November 5, 2011}}</ref> between January and December 1, 2004.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cdjapan.co.jp/detailview.html?KEY=SVWB-1613|title=NARUTO 2nd Stage Vol.1|publisher=CDJapan|access-date=November 5, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cdjapan.co.jp/detailview.html?KEY=ANSB-1624|title=NARUTO 2nd Stage Vol.12|publisher=CDJapan|access-date=November 5, 2011}}</ref> Episodes from this season were released on by Viz Media between the ninth and twenty-first DVD volumes from the series,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.vizmedia.com/product?id=6654|title=Naruto, Vol. 9 (DVD)|publisher=[[Viz Media]]|access-date=November 6, 2011|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120529002540/http://www.vizmedia.com/product?id=6654|archive-date=May 29, 2012}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.vizmedia.com/product?id=7138|title=Naruto, Vol. 21 (DVD)|publisher=[[Viz Media]]|access-date=November 6, 2011}}</ref> while several uncut DVD boxes have also been released.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.vizmedia.com/product?id=9432|title=Naruto Uncut Season 2, Vol. 1 (DVD Box Set)|publisher=[[Viz Media]]|access-date=November 6, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.vizmedia.com/product?id=9433|title=Naruto Uncut Season 2, Vol. 2 (DVD Box Set)|publisher=[[Viz Media]]|access-date=November 6, 2011}}</ref>

Seven pieces of [[theme music]] are used for the episodes in Japanese version; three opening themes and four closing themes. The first opening theme is {{Nihongo|"[[Hōkai Amplifier|Haruka Kanata]]"|遥か彼方||lit. ''Far Away''}} by [[Asian Kung-Fu Generation]] (used for episodes 36 to 53), {{Nihongo|"Kanashimi Wo Yasashisa Ni"|悲しみをやさしさに||lit. ''Sadness into Kindness''}} by [[Little by Little (band)|Little By Little]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.cdjapan.co.jp/product/MHCL-173|title=ROCKS HOUND DOG CD Maxi|work=CDJapan|access-date=May 31, 2017|language=en|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141024203409/http://www.cdjapan.co.jp/product/MHCL-173|archive-date=October 24, 2014}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.cdjapan.co.jp/product/KSCL-542|title=Houkai Amplifier ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION CD Album|work=CDJapan|access-date=May 31, 2017|language=en|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161109190917/http://www.cdjapan.co.jp/product/KSCL-542|archive-date=November 9, 2016}}</ref> (used for episodes 54 to 77), and "[[Go (Flow song)|Go!!!]]" by [[Flow (Japanese band)|Flow]] (used for episodes 81 to 83). The four closing themes are "[[Harmonia (Rythem song)|Harmonia]]" by [[Rythem]] (used for episodes 36 to 51), "Viva★Rock" by [[Orange Range]] (used for episodes 52 to 64),<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.hmv.co.jp/artist_Akeboshi_000000000204487/item_Akeboshi_1067218|title=Akeboshi|work=ローチケHMV|access-date=May 31, 2017|archive-url=https://archive.today/20170531192320/http://www.hmv.co.jp/artist_Akeboshi_000000000204487/item_Akeboshi_1067218|archive-date=May 31, 2017|language=ja|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.cdjapan.co.jp/product/AICL-1673|title=Harmonia RYTHEM CD Maxi|work=CDJapan|access-date=May 31, 2017|language=en|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141124223738/http://www.cdjapan.co.jp/product/AICL-1673|archive-date=November 24, 2014}}</ref> "Alive" by Raico (used for episodes 65 to 77), and {{Nihongo|"Ima Made Nando Mo"|今まで何度も||lit. ''Many Times Before''}} by [[The Mass Missile]] (used for episodes 78 to 83). The opening theme for the English airing are "Rise" by Jeremy Sweet and Ian Nickus (used until episode 52), "Haruka Kanata" by [[Asian Kung-Fu Generation]] (used for episodes 53 to 80), and is then replaced by "GO!!!" in the same way as the Japanese version, while the closing theme is an instrumental version of "Rise", which is used in all episodes.

| ShortSummary    = While Neji recovers, Hiashi visits him and reveals the truth behind Hizashi's death. But the Hyuga clan plan to have Hizashi, Hiashi's younger twin brother, die in his place to keep the Byakugan of a main house Hyuga from falling into enemy hands. Despite Hiashi disapproving of his brother being sacrificed, Hizashi agrees to die on his own freewill to protect his brother. Meanwhile, the match between [[Sasuke Uchiha]] and Gaara is postponed due to Sasuke's absence, and the match between [[List of Naruto characters#Shino Aburame|Shino Aburame]] and [[List of Naruto characters#Kankuro|Kankuro]] is set to start. | ShortSummary    = As the battles across Konoha rage on, Hiruzen has his clones use the Reaper Death Seal on the Senju brothers. As the corpses used to reanimate the first two Hokage are revealed to be Kin and Zaku, Hiruzen reveals that the Reaper Death Seal is a double-edge attack that the Fourth Hokage used to seal the Nine-Tails with his own soul as the price. Having given up two thirds of his own soul to seal the Senju brothers within the Reaper's stomach, Hiruzen intends to feed what remains of his own soul and Orochimaru's soul to the monster as well. However, Orochimaru has the Kusanagi stab Hiruzen in the back. Sasuke catches up with the Sand Siblings again. Before Gaara escapes with Temari, Shino Aburame arrives to fight Kankuro.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 74
| EpisodeNumber2  = 39
| Title           = Astonishing Truth! Gaara's Identity Emerges!
| TranslitTitle   = Kyōgaku! Gaara no Shōtai
| NativeTitle     = 驚愕！我愛羅の正体
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Toshiya Niidome
| WrittenBy       = Satoru Nishizono
| Aux2            = Masaru Hyodo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|3|10}}
| AltDate         = February 10, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Leaving Shino to deal with Kankuro, Sasuke continues following Gaara. Kankuro attacks Shino with his puppet, using its many hidden weapons to catch Shino by surprise. Shino dodges the attacks through the use of his destruction bugs, but eventually makes the mistake of inhaling some of the puppet's poison gas. As the battle goes on, Shino directs his bugs to Kankuro's location. They consume his chakra once they get there, causing Kankuro to collapse. The battle won, Shino also collapses due to Kankuro's poison. Sasuke catches up with Gaara as Shino's battle ends, and the two resume their match.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 75
| EpisodeNumber2  = 40
| Title           = Sasuke's Decision: Pushed to the Edge!
| TranslitTitle   = Genkai o Koete... Sasuke no Ketsudan!!
| NativeTitle     = 限界を越えて… サスケの決断!!
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = {{StoryTeleplay|tlabel=Directed by|t=Mitsutaka Noshitani|sb=Toshiya Niidome}}
| WrittenBy       = Akatsuki Yamatoya
| Aux2            = Hideyuki Yoshida
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|3|17}}
| AltDate         = February 17, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Gaara begins transforming into [[List of Naruto characters#One-Tailed Shukaku|Shukaku]], dramatically increasing his strength and speed. Sasuke uses his Chidori to slice Gaara's arm off, but the pain only makes Gaara more determined and excited to kill Sasuke. Unable to use the Chidori a third time, Sasuke is forced to use his Cursed Seal so that he can attack Gaara again. This fails to defeat him, and Sasuke collapses due to the use of the Cursed Seal. As Gaara prepares to inflict the finishing blow, Naruto repels the attack with a kick. Naruto, Sakura, and Pakkun arrive and find Sasuke.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 76
| EpisodeNumber2  = 41
| Title           = Assassin of the Moonlit Night
| TranslitTitle   = Tsukiyo no Ansatsusha
| NativeTitle     = 月夜の暗殺者
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = {{StoryTeleplay|tlabel=Directed by|t=Rion Kujo|sb=[[Tetsurō Amino]]}}
| WrittenBy       = Akatsuki Yamatoya
| Aux2            = Yukimaro Ōtsubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|3|24}}
| AltDate         = February 24, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Gaara tries to attack Sasuke again but is covered by Sakura who gets in the way. Gaara pushes Sakura out of the way while Naruto grabs Sasuke and saves him. Gaara sufrises a pain to remember his childhood with his maternal uncle Yashamaru. While Yashamaru had for many years been the only person who seemed to care for him, Gaara was shocked to find Yashamaru suddenly attacking him out of sheer hatred.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 77
| EpisodeNumber2  = 42
| Title           = Light vs. Dark: The Two Faces of Gaara
| TranslitTitle   = Hikari to Yami - Gaara Toiu na
| NativeTitle     = 光と闇 我愛羅という名
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = {{StoryTeleplay|tlabel=Directed by|t=Shūji Miyahara|sb=Toshiya Niidome}}
| WrittenBy       = Kou Hei Mushi
| Aux2            = Akira Matsushima
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|3|31}}
| AltDate         = March 3, 2007
| ShortSummary    = As Gaara sufrises to reminisce about Yashamaru, he remembers Yashamaru's statement of his mother's death and his uncle's suicide bombing. Though Gaara survived the blast - thanks to the sand shield - he lost the only person who ever cared for him. From that point on, Gaara came to love only himself and started to find purpose in killing others. Returning to the present, Gaara keeps his grip on Sakura with his sand claw choking her to death. Gaara, feeling deranged, asks Naruto to play a game with him saying that if he can beat him, Sakura will be set free. Determined to save Sakura, an enraged Naruto violently attacks Gaara and they engage in battle.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 78
| EpisodeNumber2  = 43
| Title           = Naruto's Ninja Handbook
| TranslitTitle   = Bakuhatsu! Korezo Naruto Ninpōchō~~!!
| NativeTitle     = 爆発！これぞナルト忍法帖～～っ!!
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Masaaki Kumagai
| WrittenBy       = Satoru Nishizono
| Aux2            = Hiromi Okazaki
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|4|7}}
| AltDate         = March 10, 2007
| ShortSummary    = With the lives of his comrades at stake, a determined Naruto manages to get rid of his fear of Gaara. Rejuvenated, Naruto uses techniques from his Ninja Handbook scroll. Naruto unleashes new and improved Naruto Uzumaki Barrage consisting of 2,000 shadow clones (Naruto Uzumaki 2k Barrage). Eight shadow clones kick Gaara into the air and all 2,000 shadow clones punch Gaara on every inch of his body before two shadow clones deliver the final blow to the barrage. Naruto attempts a second attack twice as powerful, with kicks. To fend off the attack, Gaara explodes his complete transformation into a replica of Shukaku, the One-Tailed Tanuki. Gaara tries to crush Naruto with his sand. Thinking of Sakura, Sasuke and his friends, Naruto uses his own chakra to summon Gamabunta. Gaara forces himself to sleep and allows Shukaku to take over. Needing to get close to Shukaku to wake Gaara up, Naruto and Gamabunta transform into a replica of the Nine-Tails to fight.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 79
| EpisodeNumber2  = 44
| Title           = Beyond the Limit of Darkness and Light
| TranslitTitle   = Rimitto Bucchigiri! "Hikari to Yami"
| NativeTitle     = リミットぶっちぎり！～光と闇～
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = {{StoryTeleplay|tlabel=Directed by|t=Hiroshi Kimura|sb=Ryō Yasumura}}
| WrittenBy       = Satoru Nishizono
| Aux2            = Kazuya Saitō
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|4|14}}
| AltDate         = March 17, 2007
| ShortSummary    = As the transformed Gamabunta holds Shukaku in place, Naruto awakens Gaara. Tapping into the Nine-Tails's chakra again, Naruto headbutts Gaara and destroys Shukaku's form. Across Konoha, the village's ninja, including the parents of many of the Genin, begin the counterattack of the invading forces. At the site of his battle with Orochimaru, Hiruzen realizes that he does not have enough strength left to fully seal Orochimaru's soul, and instead opts to seal the part of his former pupil's soul within his arms. Robbing Orochimaru his ability to use ninjutsu, Hiruzen happily dies after bidding farewell to him.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 80
| EpisodeNumber2  = 45
| Title           = The Third Hokage, Forever...
| TranslitTitle   = Sandaime yo, Towa ni......!!
| NativeTitle     = 三代目よ、永久に……!!
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = {{StoryTeleplay|tlabel=Directed by|t=Akira Shimizu|sb=Junya Koshiba}}
| WrittenBy       = Akatsuki Yamatoya
| Aux2            = Chikara Sakurai
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|4|21}}
| AltDate         = March 24, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Critically damaged, Orochimaru calls off the invasion and flees the village with his forces despite his sealed arms. In the forest, Naruto and Gaara both lay on the ground, devoid of chakra. Naruto sympathizes with Gaara for his childhood, but threatens to kill Gaara if he should ever bring harm to his friends again. Realizing that Naruto's strength came from the desire to protect others, Gaara begins to reshape his view of the world as his siblings take him home, and apologizes to Temari and Kankuro. The next day, Naruto and the ninja of Konoha mourn the deaths of those who died during the invasion, including Hiruzen. Kakashi does not attend the funeral and reminisces about Obito, as Jiraiya watches on and remembers his time in Hiruzen’s genin squad.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode table/part|subtitle=Search for Tsunade|c=#7BB842}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 81
| EpisodeNumber2  = 46
| Title           = Return of the Morning Mist
| TranslitTitle   = Asagiri no Kikyō
| NativeTitle     = 朝霧の帰郷
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = Yuki Hayashi
| WrittenBy       = Kou Hei Mushi
| Aux2            = Yasuhiko Kanezuka
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|4|28}}
| AltDate         = March 31, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Jiraiya reveals to be the pupil alongside Orochimaru. When the village's elders offer the position of the Fifth Hokage for Jiraiya, he declines it, saying that his former teammate [[Tsunade]] will be a candidate. Jiraiya offers to find her for Konoha and asks that he be allowed to take Naruto with him. Meanwhile, [[Itachi Uchiha]] and [[List of Naruto characters#Kisame Hoshigaki|Kisame Hoshigaki]] enter Konoha, and are confronted by Asuma Sarutobi and [[List of Naruto characters#Kurenai Yuhi|Kurenai Yuhi]]. Itachi and Kisame quickly gain the advantage in battle, but [[Kakashi Hatake]] comes to their rescue at the last moment.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 82
| EpisodeNumber2  = 47
| Title           = Eye to Eye: Sharingan vs. Sharingan!
| TranslitTitle   = Sharingan tai Sharingan!!
| NativeTitle     = 写輪眼{{Ruby-ja|VS|たい}}写輪眼!!
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = {{StoryTeleplay|tlabel=Directed by|t=Rion Kujo|sb=Toshiya Niidome}}
| WrittenBy       = Yuka Miyata
| Aux2            = Yukimaro Ōtsubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|5|5}}
| AltDate         = April 7, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Kakashi and Itachi exchange blows, each being very proficient with the Sharingan. Itachi neutralizes Kakashi with his genjutsu Tsukuyomi. As Kakashi struggles to remain standing, he asks Itachi why he returned to Konoha. Itachi replies that they are after Naruto, which Kakashi elaborates as meaning they want the Nine-Tails for their organization [[List of Naruto characters#Akatsuki|Akatsuki]]. Annoyed that Kakashi knows of their organization, Itachi instructs Kisame to kill Asuma and Kurenai, before bringing Kakashi to him so they can find out what else he knows of their group. Before Kisame can do so, [[List of Naruto characters#Might Guy|Might Guy]] arrives. Itachi and Kisame leave the battle.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
{{Episode list/sublist|Naruto season 2
| EpisodeNumber   = 83
| EpisodeNumber2  = 48
| Title           = Jiraiya: Naruto's Potential Disaster!
| TranslitTitle   = Ō, Nō~! Jiraiya no Jonan, Naruto no Sainan
| NativeTitle     = おお、のォ～っ！自来也の女難、ナルトの災難
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja
| DirectedBy      = {{StoryTeleplay|tlabel=Directed by|t=Mamoru Enomoto|sb=Tetsurō Amino}}
| WrittenBy       = Michiko Yokote
| Aux2            = Hideyuki Yoshida
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2004|5|12}}
| AltDate         = April 14, 2007
| ShortSummary    = Guy, Asuma, and Kurenai take an unconscious Kakashi home to rest, where they decide [[Sasuke Uchiha]] should not know of Itachi's return. Despite their wishes, Sasuke finds out, and learns that his older brother Itachi is after [[Naruto Uzumaki]]. Determined to kill Itachi and avenge the Uchiha clan, Sasuke rushes out to find Naruto, though he discovers that Naruto has already left the village with Jiraiya. In another town, Naruto sits in a hotel room while Jiraiya tries to pick up a woman. After someone knocks on a door, Naruto opens it to reveal Itachi and Kisame standing before him.
| LineColor       = 7BB842
}}
